latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — automated client follow-up workflow to identify and engage stale leads.

- Scans your client or lead list to detect contacts you haven’t reached out to recently.
- Ranks and prioritizes follow-ups based on deal value, last interaction, and lead stage.
- Drafts personalized follow-up messages (never sent without approval) and generates a follow-up digest.
- Delivers summary digests via file or messaging channels; supports on-demand and weekly scheduled runs.
- Logs outreach actions and updates last-contacted dates to keep your process organized.
- Highly configurable: thresholds, follow-up style, delivery channel, list source (CSV, Google Sheets, CRM), and more.
